name: rt_sigtimedwait
synopsis: int sigwaitinfo(const sigset_t *restrict set, siginfo_t *_Nullable restrict info);
int sigtimedwait(const sigset_t *restrict set, siginfo_t *_Nullable restrict info, const struct timespec *restrict timeout);
description: rt_sigtimedwait is a system call that synchronously waits for queued signals specified in a set, with an optional timeout. It removes the signal from the pending set and returns its number, along with additional information if provided.

parameters.name: set
parameters.description: Pointer to a set of signals to wait for

parameters.name: info
parameters.description: Pointer to a siginfo_t structure to receive signal information, or NULL if not needed

parameters.name: timeout
parameters.description: Pointer to a timespec structure specifying the timeout period, or NULL for indefinite wait

return_value.success: Returns the signal number (a value greater than zero)
return_value.failure: Returns -1 and sets errno to indicate the error

errors.description: No signal in set became pending within the timeout period
The wait was interrupted by a signal handler for a signal not in set

bugs: Silently ignores attempts to wait for SIGKILL and SIGSTOP; cannot be used to receive synchronously generated signals like SIGSEGV or SIGFPE; in multithreaded programs, which thread receives a signal is indeterminate.
